Previous findings demonstrated that TRPV4 channels interact with calcium-activated potassium channels in the PVN, leading to a reduced action potential firing frequency in response to hypotonic conditions, which correspond to low osmolality. Katsuwonus pelamis, commonly known as skipjack, is a small tuna species found in tropical and subtropical waters worldwide. The text evaluates the filefish yield from the processing of tilapia (Oreochromis spp.) in a company located in Minas Gerais, Brazil, during January to November 2004. A total of 4,260 tilapias, weighing 2,560 kg, were processed, with individual fish weights ranging from 300 to 1,000 grams, leading to a mean individual weight of 600 grams. Light leaf spot disease, caused by P. brassicae, is economically damaging and poses a risk of evolving due to its mixed reproduction system and the presence of airborne ascospores. This situation highlights the urgent need for diverse sources of host resistance to mitigate the yield losses associated with this disease.
